bull_bear.body:
- Deleveraging is a stated priority: consolidated Net Debt/EBITDA improved to 4.47x in 2QFY27 from 5.38x in 1QFY27 and 9.82x in 2QFY26; consolidated net debt fell to ₹7,444 Cr from ₹7,704 Cr in Q1, with cash of ₹1,063 Cr.
- Credit ratings upgraded to CRISIL AA- and ICRA AA-, which management attributes to stronger cash flows and treasury discipline; management states it will keep prioritising deleveraging and cost of funds as new capacity comes online.
- Stock included in the Nifty 500 and Nifty Smallcap 250 indices.
- Free cash flow (pre-capex) of ₹418 Cr in 2QFY27.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Positions itself as India's 5th Largest Private Thermal Power Producer, supplying power to Discoms nationwide through long-term partnerships and supporting emerging grid requirements.
- Strategic ambition is to become one of India's top three private thermal power producers by FY33, via asset reliability, organic expansion and turnaround of acquired capacity.
- 29% of operating capacity is strategically located near coal mines, supporting fuel-cost positioning.
- Vision: 'Leading energy security with reliable power, for a future that inspires inclusive and sustainable growth.'
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Corporate rename] Company renamed from Talwandi Sabo Power Limited to Vedanta Power Limited.
- [Demerger] Financial data presented for the quarter/half-year covers the full period from 1 April 2026 and is not limited to the period following the demerger, which became effective 1 May 2026.
- [Legal recovery] A favourable OERC judgement enabled recovery of legacy ash disposal cost at Jharsuguda; ₹58 Cr recovered in 2QFY27 with EBITDA and FCF benefit; ash revenues at JIPP rose from ₹1.61 Cr (Q2 FY26) to ₹8.74 Cr (Q2 FY27).
